facts.text: An Indian was killed when two helicopters (Fishtail Air, Air Dynasty) collided near **Everest Base Camp**, Nepal.
facts.plain: An Indian was killed when two helicopters (Fishtail Air, Air Dynasty) collided near Everest Base Camp, Nepal.

facts.text: Fire at the **HPCL Visakh Refinery** (Residue Upgradation Facility), Visakhapatnam; no casualties.
facts.plain: Fire at the HPCL Visakh Refinery (Residue Upgradation Facility), Visakhapatnam; no casualties.

facts.text: Two foreign nationals (a German Lufthansa crew member and a Slovak) died of suspected electrocution in the pool of the **Conrad Hotel**, Bengaluru; police booked the hotel management for negligence.

facts.text: Delhi: a magisterial probe was ordered into the **7 Oct Seemapuri** building collapse (5 dead); a fire at a shoe factory in **Mangolpuri** Industrial Area killed four.
